events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a true icon. The impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message still resonates deeply today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, whose guitar mastery continues to inspire generations of musicians. He would have been 84 today.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Celebration
angles.copy: The album that gave us 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'. Still sounding incredible 57 years later.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the formidable Chrissie Hynde, a true rock 'n' roll legend and frontwoman of The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid is another year older! Celebrating the 54th birthday of the one and only Liam Gallagher today. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: A timeless message of peace and unity. John Lennon's 'Imagine' remains as powerful today as it was on release 51 years ago.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Before streaming, there was the iPod. Remembering the device that put a thousand songs in your pocket and revolutionised how we listen to music 25 years ago.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film.

angles.name: Bond Day Celebration
angles.copy: From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, we're celebrating all things 007 on James Bond Day. Which Bond is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and legacy live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese. A master of comedy who has brought us so much laughter.

events.title: 'The White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Celebration
angles.copy: Experimental, sprawling, and utterly brilliant. The Beatles' 'White Album' still captivates listeners 58 years on.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary talent and electrifying stage presence of Freddie Mercury, gone but never forgotten. He would have been 80 today.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Celebration
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in The Beatles' evolution. 'Rubber Soul' showcased their growing songwriting maturity and sonic experimentation 61 years ago.
